question: Does WP79's Hessian-fit dense / diagonal auto-selection, unchanged, qualify as the default on all 22 v7 posteriors x 6 fresh seeds and a 30-seed funnel?
library_under_test: wt/metric-autoselect-confirmation: main fa04c5b9 (WP79 merged) plus one scope commit. Statistic, thresholds and decision code unchanged from WP79: DenseAutoSelectConfig::hessian_fit(2, 5.0, 0.5). The one change, made before any cell and disclosed here: two of the five hard posteriors exceed DenseMass::MAX_DIMENSION (radon_hierarchical_intercept_centered d = 391, grsm_latent_reg_irt d = 408), where WP79's code returns a configuration error. For d > 256 the flag is now ineligible: the run is the unflagged diagonal run, with no decision recorded ('diag-cap'). A default cannot error where the diagonal runs, and no dense branch exists there. tests/metric_autoselect_hessian.rs gains the bit-identity test for this path.

selection.rule: From every chain's slow windows 1+2 (150 draws per chain, 600 pooled): pooled within-chain covariance C of z = (x, g), x the unconstrained position and g the log-density gradient at each selected draw. B = C_gx C_xx^-1; linearity = min_i R^2_i, R^2_i = (C_gx C_xx^-1 C_xg)_ii / (C_gg)_ii; P = -(B + B^T)/2; if P is positive definite, Sigma = P^-1 and G_H = kappa_diag / kappa_dense of Sigma whitened by its Stan-regularised (n = 500) diagonal and dense estimates (the population version of WP48's k, so WP75's threshold 5 keeps its WP48/WP51 justification). Dense iff P is SPD, G_H >= 5 and linearity >= 0.5. The WP75 window-whitening G is recorded too (descriptive).

machine: AWS c7a.4xlarge owalnuts-bench, lane 3: every build and cell under taskset -c 8-11, RAYON_NUM_THREADS=4, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, files under ~/lanes/metric_autoselect_confirmation_v1/ only; co-tenanted, walls 'pinned, co-tenanted' and not used in any rule.
dispatch: owalnuts_bridgestan::ReplicatedStanTarget with 4 replicas (WP65 ReplicatedConcurrent, recorded per cell); 4 threads for 4 chains.

arms.auto: Sampler::new().adaptation(Adaptation::Custom(WarmupConfig::new(0.8).with_warmup_exhaustion_rule(DEFAULT_WARMUP_EXHAUSTION).with_metric_regularization(DEFAULT_METRIC_REGULARIZATION).with_dense_auto_select(DenseAutoSelectConfig::hessian_fit(2, 5.0, 0.5)))) with the default diagonal metric; funnel: Metric::diagonal() and the same adaptation.

parameter_set.reference_posteriors: columns of the posteriordb reference draws (18 posteriors: the 17 house models and kilpisjarvi); oWALNUTS draws constrained through BridgeStan with transformed parameters included (v6 rule)
parameter_set.gates_only_posteriors: the four posteriors without posteriordb reference draws (GLMM_Poisson, seeds_centered, grsm_latent_reg_irt, radon hierarchical_intercept_centered): every constrained parameter-block coordinate, transformed parameters and generated quantities excluded (WP46 rule); no z statistic; coordinates with undefined ArviZ statistics are listed and ignored by the nan-ignoring minima, as in v6/WP46

predicted_branch_basis: House models: WP79's observed branches (earnings and kidiq diagonal, accepted). Hard models, no calibration draws: kilpisjarvi (d 3, a linear trend regression with strongly correlated intercept and slope, near-Gaussian) dense; GLMM_Poisson (d 45) and seeds_centered (d 26), hierarchical with centred group effects, funnel-like, low linearity, diag; radon and grsm_irt diag-cap.

posteriordb.reader: files read directly; no posteriordb package

bridgestan: BridgeStan 2.9.0 source (sha256 b6034f83fb2ffb71ce7be9525b7dded1a225e9a4eaf4b75d4c7e97e3ade05a4c) in the lane directory; Python bridgestan 2.9.0 and ArviZ 0.23.4 from ~/venv (read-only).
seed_check: git grep -lowE over fa04c5b9 for 8685(0[1-6]), 8684[0-3][0-9] and the pipeline seed 990685: no hit; no hit in protocol.json / PREREGISTRATION.md of C:/dev/owalnuts-wt/*/STUDIES; box lanes checked before the first cell (environment.json).
run_order: P (models in v7 order; seeds ascending; arms diag, auto), then F (seeds ascending; diag, auto). One process per cell, sequential, 4 threads, timeout 2,700 s; an errored or timed-out cell is a failed cell. Never rerun.
harness: STUDIES/metric_autoselect_v2 pdb.rs / funnel.rs unchanged except names; run_study.py adds the v7 gates-only rule (parameter-block coordinates, no z) for the four posteriors without reference draws.

statistics.headline: WP72 form (c): per model, the per-seed ratio auto / diag of min bulk ESS per gradient on seeds where both cells are ok, median across seeds; geomean over models with at least 5 of 6 paired seeds.
statistics.trapped: a trapped-chain cell has max rank R-hat > 1.1 (WP75's lotka_volterra stuck chain: 1.53).

decision_rules.R1: auto passes >= diag passes over all 132 cells.
decision_rules.R3: no model below 0.9x on the headline per-model ratio (a model without 5 paired ok seeds counts as below).
decision_rules.R4: 0 new divergences: per model, auto retained divergences over 6 seeds <= diag's.
decision_rules.R5: max |z| over passing reference-tier auto cells <= 4.
decision_rules.R6: every diagonal-branch (and diag-cap) auto cell, posteriordb and funnel, has the diag arm's per-chain draws hashes and total gradient count.
decision_rules.R7: branch identical across the 6 seeds on at least 20 of 22 models.
decision_rules.R8: funnel, 30 seeds x 4 x 2,000/20,000: |pooled P5(auto) - 0.0477903522728147| <= its between-seed s.e. Recorded as the diagonal's result by construction (every funnel run is predicted diagonal and then bit-identical).
decision_rules.R9: lotka_volterra trapped-chain cells auto <= diag (out of 6).
decision_rules.D: git diff fa04c5b9 of src, tests, Cargo.* touches only src/walnutpie.rs and tests/metric_autoselect_hessian.rs; kernel_fingerprint passes without and with research; tests/metric_autoselect.rs and tests/metric_autoselect_hessian.rs pass.
decision_rules.verdict: FLIP QUALIFIES iff R1-R9 and D all hold; the flip is the coordinator's.

reported: wall per gradient auto / diag (pinned, co-tenanted; the observer's cost), overall and by branch, and on the funnel; dense-branch warmup gradients auto / diag (median over dense cells); branch vs prediction.

predictions.branches: At least 120 of 132 auto runs as predicted_branch (24 + 3 kilpisjarvi dense models x 6 = 54 dense; 78 diag / diag-cap).
predictions.rules: All hold. R2 about 2.2 (WP79 2.20 over 17; kilpisjarvi adds a gain, the hard diag models 1.0). R7 holds unless garch11 (G_H 7, linearity 0.40) or one_comp crosses 0.5 on a seed. R8 holds with probability about 0.68 (the diagonal's own coin). R9 holds (identical first 250 transitions; dense branch was 3/3 in WP79).
predictions.wall: diag-branch wall per gradient within 1.05x (observer cost small); dense-branch higher per gradient (dense leapfrog).

proposed_flip: If every rule holds: (1) Adaptation::default() for Metric::Diagonal with mass adaptation and at least two chains adds with_dense_auto_select(DenseAutoSelectConfig::hessian_fit(2, 5.0, 0.5)) in Adaptation::warmup_config's defaults (new constant DEFAULT_DENSE_AUTO_SELECT); with_dense_auto_select and hessian_fit leave the research gate; Adaptation::Custom stays as given (opt-out: Custom without the flag, or Metric::diagonal() with a new .auto_metric(false)). (2) Not a new kernel: ALGORITHM_REVISION and kernel_fingerprint pin walnutpie::KernelTuning and do not move (WP68 refinement_levels10_v1 note, as with the MomentumSum, RejectLeaf and best-of-16 flips); sampler-level draws change only on dense-branch runs. (3) Python: no signature change; draws follow the Rust default; add keyword auto_metric=True (False restores the plain diagonal) to the config dict, DEFAULTS, README table and CHANGELOG.
pre_freeze_runs: Local Windows unit tests only. After the freeze: the pipeline check on seed 990685 (kidiq diag/auto, a GLMM gates-only diag cell, a plain-feature diag cell, one funnel cell per arm) in the lane scratch directory, not committed.
